items.title: Explicit defining relations for the level-one Demazure module of a finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra
items.author: Bhimarthi Ravinder
items.work: Demazure Modules, Chari-Venkatesh Modules and Fusion Products
items.difficulty_reason: The claim is a complete presentation of the level-one Demazure module D(1,k theta), so the proof has to match the two relation families (dm1) and (dm2) that define the level-one Demazure quotient (source lines 381-393) against the relations of the local Weyl module W(k theta). The decisive step is the root-system dichotomy <k theta, alpha^vee> = 0 or k d_alpha for alpha in R^+ different from theta (lines 427-429), which kills the whole family (dm2) and reduces (dm1) to the short roots with (theta|alpha) = 1. The remaining long-root case is not formal either: it uses the relation (w2') obtained from Garland's identity (line 440). The resulting list is exactly the presentation later sections use for D(1,k theta), so it cannot be replaced by a citation to the definition of the local Weyl module.
